items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I told you why. About the Detention Home situation, how much I appreciate the Judge making the decision he made because he knew later on in life I was going to do more harm than what I did.

ctx.x: Why? Why --you've got the question of why and I told you why. About the Detention Home situation, how much I appreciate the Judge making the decision he made because he knew later on in life I was going to do more harm than what I did. And that's only the beginning -- and at my age, what am I going to do with somebody that hangs out with me that's older than me, that hangs out with me. See what I mean? So I give the Judge credit for using the judgment he used by letting my mother take me out of the school, take…

way of introducing us that was superior. Superior. He would go to your house or any friend's house who were white, ring the bell and his entrance was, "let us niggers in and if you don't want us niggers here we'll leave." They liked him so well that they over- looked that we were colored. They received him and Buck and I as though we were one of them. If we entertained, we were four times greater.
